full_vs_mini.full_linux_armhf_puma: supports RKNN Toolkit online debugging / host-connected runtime
full_vs_mini.mini_linux_armhf_puma_mini: supports precompiled RKNN models only and does not support Toolkit online debugging
full_vs_mini.classification_rule: A mini-driver incompatibility or non-precompiled-model rejection is an environment failure, not trained-decoder image-quality failure.

f5a_requirement: Use a compatible full PUMA runtime/driver stack for host-connected RKNN-Toolkit 1.7.5 init_runtime(target='rv1126').
f5b_requirement: The on-board C harness must link against the original RKNPU1 runtime matching the installed RV1126 driver. Record RKNN_QUERY_SDK_VERSION before timing.

timing_evidence.claim_scope: model-only real-device inference timing; never full 1080p60 pipeline timing
